findings.problem: An error-level decoder diagnostic could be ignored when FFmpeg returned0.
findings.resolution: Both picture and audio full-decode gates require zero exit and empty error stderr; audio additionally verifies finite values, actual decoded sample count, channel count and rate.

findings.problem: An unrelated decodable file could satisfy generic completion; room clocks and complete output set were not enforced.
findings.resolution: Expected native report and deliverable sets are required, room output set is derived from the retained report, and source-reel/full-source samples are checked separately.

findings.problem: An audio-only main MP4 could bypass picture checks.
findings.resolution: The required main movie must have video before frame count, dimensions, rate and full-decode checks.

findings.problem: Receipt joins and post-run checks did not cover every dependency copy actually consumed.
findings.resolution: Native source/audio/recipe/fields/font/composition/track/session/code hashes and time maps are checked where emitted; staged input bytes are rechecked after execution.

findings.problem: A staging failure could be labeled render_executed even before process launch.
findings.resolution: native_started is set only after Popen succeeds and used in failure receipts; unsupported result and process errors remain explicit.
